title: Boston-based Aevius, whose foundation models analyze patient health using medical records, imaging, and other data, raised a $22M seed led by Insight Partners (Katherine Davis/Axios)
summary: Katherine Davis / Axios: Boston-based Aevius, whose foundation models analyze patient health using medical records, imaging, and other data, raised a $22M seed led by Insight Partners — Clinical intelligence startup Aevius raised $22 million in seed funding from Insight Partners, CEO Rowland Pettit exclusively tells Axios Pro.
